name: company
description: Runs a PHP project like a small software company: a project manager plus developer, code-review and QA agents, with safety hooks.

story_budget.title: Budget per story (US dollars)
story_budget.description: API-equivalent dollars one story may cost before the PM stops and asks you. You get a warning at 80%. A project can set its own in .claude/project/budget.md.

project_budget.title: Budget per project (US dollars, 0 = no cap)
project_budget.description: API-equivalent dollars a whole project may cost before the PM stops and asks you. 0 means no cap; the PM suggests one when a project starts.
